integrity: The finite checker corroborates the explicit proof but is not an infinite proof; no independent assessment or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The explicit stabilization bound is sufficient rather than parameterwise minimal; finite short lengths, more than two runs, larger alphabets, and binomial orders above two are not classified. Aperiodic and general power-matrix results are compared but unindexed equivalent work cannot be ruled out.
title: Gcd-governed eventual two-binomial complexity with quadratic collision delays
